articles.title: Wireshark 4.6.10 Released With Patch for 39 Security Vulnerabilities
articles.summary:
Wireshark 4.6.10 has been released with fixes for 39 security vulnerabilities affecting protocol dissectors, capture file parsers, the dissection engine, and audio codecs. The update addresses crashes, processing loops, memory leaks, and a heap disclosure issue that could affect systems used for network troubleshooting and security analysis. articles.title: Hackers Leak Customer Data Linked to Visa, Mastercard and JPMorgan After Third-Party Cyberattacks
articles.summary:

articles.title: Drupal Fixes Critical RCE Flaw That Could Let Unauthenticated Hackers Take Over Websites

articles.title: New Unpatched Windows 0-Day FastUnlock Lets Someone Holding a Locked PC Run Programs on It
articles.summary:
A newly disclosed unpatched zero-day technique called FastUnlock lets someone with physical access to a locked Windows computer start programs without signing in. Whoever uses it gets only a limited account, not administrator control of the machine.

The method was posted yesterday by a researcher who uses the handles MSNightmare and Nightmare Eclipse, and the endpoint-security firm ThreatLocker
